title: Chapter 165
text:
"Hopefully, the replica will be 40% effective. That should be enough."

Han Xiao did not have enough advanced knowledge, so he could only make a prototype with fewer functions like the Ghost sniper rifle. However, there was an advantage to creating a mech. Even if he created a prototype, it would not have the same limitations as the Ghost sniper rifle.

Creating a self-made mech was a huge project that could not be completed in a short time. Han Xiao planned to complete the various modules when he ran to the newbie village.

He also wanted to integrate some new blueprints to improve the functions of the mech.

The core energy was the "Bonfire" mini reactor. He had to wait for Lei Zhen Yu to order it. This was also an advanced mech, so he could not make it. Luckily, he knew other mechanics and could borrow their skills.

Speaking of which, Old Man Lu's four blueprints were also rare items. The opportunity for the mission was to leave Black Pine, and it had not started yet. The four blueprints could form a set of offensive and defensive systems that could be used together with the mech.

The second battle plan was the mech, and Old Man Lu's four blueprints could directly form the third battle plan. Han Xiao was looking forward to it. The three battle plans complemented each other, and the mech's attributes were very strong. Even if he faced Bennett, he would not have to be afraid.

"As long as I finish running to the newbie village and get a huge amount of experience, I can start to do something big." Han Xiao calculated the time and suddenly raised his eyebrows.

"If I remember correctly, the Inhuman Incident is about to start."

…

There were five newbie villages in the Southern Continent. Excluding Big Horn Village and Green Valley Village, Han Xiao spent 11 days running to the remaining three villages. Most of the time was spent on the road. Every time he reached a newbie village, players would swarm there without him doing anything. Some would change classes, and some would cause trouble.

This was all due to the popularity of the Galaxy Times and forum posts. Han Xiao had left a deep impression on the players, and they all knew what to do with him.

Han Xiao counted, and the number of players who chose to change their class to Mechanic was between twenty-five to thirty percent. This ratio was much higher than in his previous life. Although Blue Star only had three main classes, the ratio was not evenly distributed. In his previous life, the ratio was thirty percent for Esper classes, fifty to sixty percent for Pugilist classes, and ten percent for Mechanic classes. After Han Xiao's marketing, this ratio had tripled!

Other than Basic Knowledge, he also taught [Basic Shooting] and [Basic Combat]. The target audience for Basic Skills was much wider. Most players would come to learn these two Basic Skills. This was the main focus!

Many a little makes a mickle, many grains of sand make a tower, small profits but quick turnover. Not to mention the benefits of helping players change their class …

Three Novice Villages gave him a total of 9.023 million experience!

The efficiency was astonishing!

The EXP efficiency of these 11 days was comparable to more than a dozen high-difficulty bounty missions! In his previous life, players of the same level would have to spend at least a few months to accumulate that much experience!

The powerful effect of the interface and the NPC template allowed him to grow at a terrifying rate. At the very least, he now had an endless source of experience points!

The player market indeed had the most potential. Furthermore, he could temporarily dominate the market and create a shocking amount of profit.

With a huge amount of experience points in hand, Han Xiao did not say anything and immediately raised his [Trainee Mechanic] class to Lv.15.

His total level was now LV 55, and he needed to change his class to level up. He was still five levels away from the level cap of Version 1.0, but he was not restricted by the level cap of this version. Han Xiao was very likely to be the first person in Blue Star to reach LV 60. However, the requirements for the class change were extremely troublesome.

[Trainee Mechanic] level up to Lv.15. + 120 Energy, + 1 DEX, + 1 END, + 4 INT. You have received 3 Free Attribute Points. You have received 1 Potential Point!

Class Change Mission: Create five [Rare] grade machines with an Energy Rank of not lower than 60.

"F * ck, what kind of luck is this? Am I that unlucky? I got one of the most troublesome class change requirements?"

Han Xiao was stunned.

Rare grade was purple, one level higher than blue. The machines he created now had a 15% to 20% chance of being blue, but the chances of being purple were only 1% to 2%.

The quality of a machine was the horizontal difference between similar equipment. For example, a normal retractable knife would have a huge difference in attributes between white and blue equipment. Blue equipment had more additional effects, but a blue retractable knife could not be compared to a white ranger robot at all.

The quality of a machine was the difference between similar equipment. For example, cold weapons, firearms, grenades, robots … The attributes of a machine were based on the template of the same type of machine. To make it easier to understand, I'll use familiar things as an example. For example, a high-quality shaver can be very smooth and comfortable when shaving, but it can't be used for cooking. That's the reason. Different types of equipment have their own functions, and each profession has its own specialization.

The higher the quality of a machine, the harder it was to increase its quality. Intelligence affected the quality of the finished product, and it was the core attribute of a Mechanic. It was easier for high-level Mechanics to create high-quality low-level machines.

However, the Class Change requirement of 'Energy Rank of not lower than 60' prevented him from using low-level machines to increase the quality of the machines. He had to create purple machines that matched his level.

This kind of Class Change requirement was known as one of the most difficult requirements because normally, when one had just reached the upper limit of one's level, they would not be able to steadily create machines of sufficient quality. It was either to try luck or to increase one's skills or obtain talents. No matter which one it was, it was very time-consuming.

Han Xiao's face was as black as the bottom of a pot … in various ways.

The Class Change was difficult, so he used EXP to increase his skills and fuse blueprints, especially blueprints. This was a bottomless pit of EXP.

Han Xiao spent almost 5,000,000 EXP to level up five times in a row. Of the remaining EXP, he left 2,000,000 for Knowledge Fusion and threw the rest into his skills. This time, he maxed out [Intermediate Machinery Affinity] and [Basic Refinement].

Intermediate Machinery Affinity was the core skill, and its cost was very high, but its effect was very obvious.

Machinery Affinity affected the quality of the machine, which was beneficial for completing the Class Change mission.

"Experience is fleeting. It comes and goes quickly."

Han Xiao let out a sigh of relief. He felt very satisfied that he had spent a huge amount of EXP in one go.

After clearing the Novice Village in Southern Continent, Han Xiao decided to go to Western Continent. The countries in Western Continent were Maple and Ordina. He had been in Southern Continent for a long time, and now, he was finally going to another continent.

"This time, I can do the hidden mission. The Tragedy of Robert Potter happened in Western Continent," Han Xiao thought to himself.

…

As they were going to fly across the ocean, the transport plane was parked at the airport of Hesla Port City to prepare for the long-distance flight. They had prepared enough jet fuel. This was Antonio's territory, so Han Xiao spent a lot of money and emptied Antonio's warehouse. There were a lot of materials on the plane.

"You're going to Western Continent?" Antonio held a thick black cigar in his mouth and patted Han Xiao's shoulder with his bear-like hand. "An assassin like you will definitely be on the threat list of every country. The agents of Maple and Ordina might want to have afternoon tea with you. That is not your home ground, and our influence in Western Continent is limited. Let me give you a piece of advice: try not to show yourself."

"So?"

"Be careful."

Han Xiao pretended to be surprised and said, "Wow, so you can finish your sentence in one sentence."

Antonio was speechless.

"Don't worry, I won't be reckless." Han Xiao patted Antonio's thick arm and walked onto the plane.

The plane was filled with fuel, took off, and disappeared into the sky.

…

Han Xiao went to all the novice villages in the Southern Continent and caused quite a commotion on the forums. The novice players from the other three continents were envious of the Southern Continent players. They wanted to meet Black Phantom too, but they could not travel across continents. They could only watch helplessly as the Southern Continent players showed off on the forums, which made them feel very uncomfortable. It was like seeing someone post pictures of delicious food in the middle of the night.

No matter how jealous they were, the helpless players could only post on the forums to vent their emotions.

"Ah, I want Black Phantom so much!"

"I have a disease that will kill me if I don't meet Black Phantom."

"Why didn't someone like Black Phantom appear in the continent I came to?"

The Southern Continent players laughed secretly, glad that they were born in a good place. Looking at the players from the other continents crying and acting cute, they felt a sense of superiority.

Ah, luck is also a part of strength. I'm not targeting anyone, but I'm saying that everyone here is trash.
